threads.title: A Place to Stand
threads.opening: We have somewhere to land. We still need somewhere to belong.
threads.escalation: The shelf is waiting; decide what you can bring to it.
threads.success: The camp is established. A place to return to is now part of the war.
threads.failure: The company came back with unfinished work. The jungle is still there.
threads.changed: The situation has changed. Reassess the home route before committing again.
threads.callback: You built a place worth returning to.

perspectives.speaker: ketha
perspectives.text: I can mend a company. Give me somewhere to put it.

choices.label: Raid for the home
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction from Greenest Fields. No deadline.
choices.response: Ketha clears a corner of the supply table. "All right. We start here. Try not to build the infirmary downhill from the ammunition."

choices.label: Establish the camp
choices.obligation: Raise the existing home camp, then complete a sortie. No deadline.
choices.response: Ketha clears a corner of the supply table. "All right. We start here. Try not to build the infirmary downhill from the ammunition."

choices.label: A home starts with who comes back.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction with explicit survivor records showing no hero wounds or losses. No deadline.
choices.response: Ketha leaves a space at the table instead of drawing a bigger perimeter. "Good. Start with people. Walls can learn to wait."
choices.success: You promised people before walls, and the field report supports that promise.
choices.callback: Ketha taps the empty chair. "Still a chair. Not a memorial. That was the plan."

threads.title: What We Bring Back
threads.reason: Extraction turns battlefield gains into a future.
threads.opening: There is always one more valuable thing beyond the line.
threads.escalation: There is still a way home. Decide what is worth carrying.
threads.success: The company completed a clean extraction. The result ledger records what survived.
threads.failure: The return was costly. Read the losses before choosing the next risk.
threads.changed: The extraction commitment has changed. Re-plan with the company you have.
threads.callback: You once chose a route home. The company remembers that.

perspectives.speaker: ketha
perspectives.text: Wrecks can wait. People are harder to rebuild.

choices.label: Make a clean return the priority
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction within three completed sorties.
choices.response: Ketha draws a heavy line beneath extraction. "This bit is part of the mission. I want that understood before we leave."

choices.label: Nobody is spare equipment.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction with explicit survivor records showing no hero wounds or losses within three completed sorties.
choices.response: Ketha closes the salvage tally. "I will still count the metal. I will just count you first."
choices.success: The survivor report backs your promise to put people first.
choices.callback: Someone has written PEOPLE at the top of the salvage board. Ketha declines to identify the handwriting.

choices.label: Take the risk that buys us a future.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction from Greenest Fields within three completed sorties. No minimum loot or optional objective is promised.
choices.response: Brakhov leans toward the map. "Then we go for a reason. Not because something over there is still standing."
choices.success: You made the raid and returned cleanly. The ledger, not the promise, decides its profit.
choices.callback: The raid is now an argument the company can refer to: ambition needs a route home.

resource.label: Tenebrium
resource.lore: Black-hole distillate metal from BAR lore. Scarce since the Generic Disaster. Build-power units cost ≥1 Tnb (ceil(buildSpeed/150)). Experimental Foundries cost 7. Named heavies stake Tnb (Sol Invictus 4, Behemoth 5, Titan 2, Juggernaut 3, Razorback 1, Thor/Catapult/Demon 2); Vanguard/Shiva/Karganeth and other combat default free. Stake lives on the unit until reclaim or vaporize. Infinite storage. Q7 is the scarcity qubit. Armada spent their stock on decoy farms — crisis, bank 0.

pool.name: Ash-Captain Vane
pool.blurb: Ash-Captain + Phobos (×12). Swarm mind — hire the flock when you want it.

pool.name: Brakhov the Kiln
pool.blurb: Incinerator siege. Name burned off. Always offense — defenses are food.

pool.name: Verse Adder
pool.blurb: Javelin pair. Counts missiles out loud. Never hits zero clean.

pool.name: Odessa Krail
pool.blurb: Telchine trio — amph line. Fords are doors.

pool.name: Cauter Bel-Ansa
pool.blurb: Shotgun foursome. Closes distance; riot is punctuation.

pool.name: Rusk Halloway
pool.blurb: Shieldline six. Held a gate with a jammed gat and a lie.

pool.name: Grath Arrears
pool.blurb: Six Karkinos — mid-line. Three wars of arrears.

pool.name: Sisu Halq
pool.blurb: Ballista battery. Shoots coordinates, not targets.

pool.name: Whisper-of-Ash Yeva
pool.blurb: Sharpshooter + five Eidolons. Whisper finds; ghosts walked.

pool.name: Spoke
pool.blurb: Null Merc kid + Wheelie Bay (×16). Only trusts wheels.

pool.name: The Last Auditor
pool.blurb: T3 ledger mech — still skirmishes like it has somewhere to be.

pool.name: Twitcher
pool.blurb: Trouble fabricator — Twitcher + Cortex nano. Mines and mischief.

pool.name: Armada Consul
pool.blurb: Deserted sideways; Consul + nano. Builds like apology.

pool.name: Veil & Compass
pool.blurb: Jammer + Compass + Gremlins. Fog is the answer.

pool.name: Cinder Hook
pool.blurb: Commando + Trappers + Hercules. Mines before the argument.

pool.name: Tick Stream
pool.blurb: Flea lab + Tick pack (×20). Speaks in plurals.

pool.name: Fatboy Contract
pool.blurb: One Fatboy — plasma house that learned to walk so it could knock.

pool.name: Bro

pool.name: Saloon Stride
pool.blurb: Stride trio — saloon glass, baked speed, bad manners.

pool.name: Hearth
pool.blurb: Quiet sun that refuses to go out — hero fusion, ENERGY field.

pool.name: Solarium
pool.blurb: Eco nest — solars, converters, storage, butler. Spreadsheets first.

pool.name: Warder
pool.blurb: Beamer ring + Ferrets + Thistles + LLTs. Owns a circle of dirt.

pool.name: Noctua Bay
pool.blurb: Drone plant + Noctua wing. Dreams in flight paths.

pool.name: Mira Barrage
pool.blurb: Parade battery — Barrage, Cleaver, Lance, Arquebus, Mausers. Confetti!

pool.name: Saint Kettle
pool.blurb: Archangel + Ferret. Sky-saint so Mira can play. Chainsaw soul.

pool.name: Infestor Hive

pool.name: Kit Sparkler

pool.name: Nox Tithe

pool.name: Ceil Rat

pool.name: Sister Lumen

pool.name: Anvil Mire

pool.name: Volt Lash
pool.blurb: Jaguar pack (x5). Lightning eyes. Sight is a wound you give them.

pool.blurb: Drives the Cortex Halberd assault hovertank.
